messages:
kyla: Quick heads-up — I opened a PR to tidy the onboarding sample app's credential flow and slim the Dockerfile. Want to avoid another round of tiny fixes later. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823

devon: Thanks — looking now. Is this the change that swaps the README example from exporting RAW_API_KEY to using the credential-helper? :eyes:

kyla: Yep. The idea: show a minimal credential helper script + env var fallback. Keeps examples secure but still easy for first-run. Also removed an obsolete pip pin that caused a conflict.

anne: One quick note — our SDK snippet in the README still shows `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("RAW_API_KEY"))`. Can we move to the new pattern? I sketched a one-liner for the snippet: `client = RedwoodClient.from_env("REDWOOD_CRED")`

suresh: Small nit — the Dockerfile had `COPY . /app` before installing deps which invalidates cache often. I pushed a suggested reorder in the PR to reduce rebuilds. Also added a short comment about multi-stage builds for smaller images.

kyla: Nice, thanks @suresh. I also added a tiny migration note: "If you're upgrading from SDK v4, replace `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)` with `client = RedwoodClient.from_env()` — see migration link."

devon: Could we include a runnable inline example that uses the credential helper script? Something folks can copy-paste in one block. Proposal (in PR):

```bash
# cred-helper.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
if [ -n "$REDWOOD_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "$REDWOOD_TOKEN"
else
  cat /run/secrets/redwood_token || echo ""
fi
```

and then the README example: `export REDWOOD_CRED=$(./cred-helper.sh)`

anne: I like the minimal helper. Can we add a short sentence about secrets managers (KMS/HSM) as the recommended long-term approach? One-line: "For production, use a secrets manager or KMS — this script is only for local dev."

mark: Quick QA: the new Dockerfile uses `python -m pip install --upgrade pip` — that broke in one container (old Alpine). Maybe change to `pip install --upgrade pip || true` or pin a compatible base image. I left a comment on the exact line.

kyla: Good catch. I'll update the PR to pin the base image and add your fallback.

docs-bot: lint-checks passed for files changed. CI: docs-build — success.

suresh: After those edits, I can approve. Also suggested a tiny wording tweak: keep the code snippet under 6 lines so it renders neatly in mobile docs.

kyla: Awesome. Thanks everyone — I'll land after another pass and allocate a follow-up issue to sweep other quickstarts for the same auth pattern. :thumbsup:

devon: If you tag the follow-up with `docs-migration` I can run a grep for old `RAW_API_KEY` occurrences and send a PR list.

kyla: Will do.
